chapter: Opinions on playing and old New Orleans
title: String bass versus tuba for a small band
summary: Foster prefers the string bass for sustain, says the tuba belongs in brass bands, and explains why he took up tuba.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

I was going to ask once about the tuba and the string bass, which you think is the best for a small, say, Dixieland type. A string bass.
Why is that? I mean, can you give a little advice on it?

A tuba, when you hear the note, it's going, boom. String bass, you got a mellow go behind that. Vibration. Vibration. Boom.
